about_the_game:
ABOUT THE GAME

Fusion Skills is a brand-new classic puzzle game that challenges you to find creative strategies to connect all Fusion Balls in an arena into one connected fusion chain.  Balance a variety of limitations and challenges to bring all the Fusion Balls together.

 

BUILT FOR REPLAYABILITY AND FRESH CHALLENGES

Each game is a procedurally generated arena with obstacles, Fusion Balls to fuse, and unique requirements that each Fusion Ball must satisfy in one shot in order to fuse.  Everything in the level – including the target score, number of Fusion Ball, Fusion Ball fusion requirements, Fusion Ball shots, etc. are all also procedurally generated.  No games even on the same level are ever the same.  Part of the fun is that to complete the level, all Fusion Balls must be fused, and you have to meet the required minimum score.

 

FUSING THE FUSION BALLS

Whenever a Fusion Ball is fused and it has met all of its minimum fusion requirements in one shot, its points are added to your total score.  The fun and challenge is also because each Fusion Ball has a certain number of times it can be shot, and can only fuse with a certain number of other Fusion Balls.  You only have a certain amount of time to shoot a Fusion Ball before a shot is taken away from a random Fusion Ball.  Since there can only be one fusion chain, your fusion skills are really tested as you figure out a way to get all the balls connected into one fusion chain.

 

INNOVATIVE AND CHALLENGING POINTS AND SCORING

In Fusion Skills, each Fusion Ball accumulates points and stats when it is in motion from being shot or being hit by another Fusion Ball.  Each Fusion Ball has the minimum points and stats – distance traveled, speed, points, and bounces – it must satisfy in one shot in order to fuse.  The more bounces and the longer each Fusion Ball travels, the more points it accumulates.  So if you need points, make the Fusion Ball bounce more and travel a longer distance.  Prepare to be amazed and entertained that the trick shots you pull off beyond what you thought was possible.

 

Each shot in Fusion Skills not only reduces the number of shots remaining for a Fusion Ball, but it also resets the fusion points and stats.  Plan each shot carefully to nab the most points you can to win the level.

 

BONUSES

Bonus Balls make it easier for you to fuse the Fusion Balls.  Bonus Balls give you extra shots, increase the time you have to take a shot, and increase the points a Fusion Ball earns as it travels and bounces.  The higher the score when you fuse a Fusion Ball, the greater the chances of you being awarded a Bonus Ball.

 

POINT BANK

You can also buy Bonus Balls with points that you earn when you complete a level.  When you complete a level, any points you earn over the target score goes into your Point Bank.  Before a game, you can use these points to purchase Bonus Balls.  Bonus Balls have point costs that change each game.

 

TIPS AND MOTIVATION

As you play the game, there are lots of tips and motivational messages to encourage you as you complete all the levels.

 

2,500 LEVELS

Yes, over 2,000 levels of pure, innovative, and fresh fun.  No two games are the same – even on the same level.  Have fun and complete all the levels.

short_description: Fusion Skills is a brand-new classic action puzzle game for all. Use trick shots and strategy to fuse balls into a single chain. With 2,500 procedurally generated levels, each game offers a new challenge. Take pride as you snatch victory from defeat. How fast will you complete all levels?
